item.description: Award-winning comedy girl band Flat & the Curves return with their well-aged cabaret, Rosé Tinted at The Loading Bay in Bradford - Part of Bradford Music Month.

item.title: Seann Walsh - This Is Torture
item.description: After his sell-out 2023 tour, the UK’s disheveled king of stand-up, award-winning Seann Walsh returns to the Studio Theatre with a brand-new hour of side-splitting comedy.
item.location: Studio Theatre, Morley Street, Bradford, West Yorkshire, BD7 1AJ

item.title: Amy Matthews
item.description: Amy doesn’t get angry and she’s starting to feel left out, so she’s on a quest to feel fury. From what she can discern from the world around her, it appears to be all the rage… literally.
item.location: Foundry, Sheffield Student's Union, Western Bank, S10 2TG

item.title: Robert Mitchell and Corey Mwamba album launch
item.description: Two incredible improvisers in a thrilling and unique duo. Composer and poet Robert Mitchell joins vibraphonist and broadcaster Corey Mwamba for a performance at Jazz at The Lescar – expect it to be intense, inspiring and beautiful.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: The Hypochondriac
item.description: Written entirely in rhyme, The Hypochondriac is Roger McGough’s hilarious take on Moliere’s 17th century comic satire of the medical profession. Presented by Sheffield University Drama Society.
item.dc:creator: Our Favourite Places

item.title: John Shuttleworth: It's Nice Up North [+Q&A]
item.description: A special, 20th-anniversary screening tour of Graham Fellows’ much loved comedy documentary It’s Nice Up North. Also presented as a tribute to the late Martin Parr, who shot the film.

item.description: Andro and Eve are having a right royal celebration. Marking ten years of The Kingdom Come drag king cabaret – one of the longest running platforms for drag king talent in the UK!

item.title: Clown College
item.description: A 6-week workshop series exploring the fundamentals of clowning – not as a set of acrobatic skills, but as a way of relating to yourself, other people and the world around you. Build your confidence through collective experimentation in a DIY space.
